title: POTS open data: where to find help, and what the evidence says
description: Two hand-checked datasets about POTS (postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome): a directory of 30 patient- and clinician-run organisations across 10 regions that help people find a POTS-literate doctor, get diagnosed, find community or long-COVID care; and cited headline figures and treatment evidence grades, each traced to a study or guideline with its sample size. Published by SPLYT: POTS (https://splyt.fit/pots). Not medical advice.
